data: Next-generation US EVA suit, to be worn on the first Artemis landing (Artemis IV)

Axiom Space's contracted EVA suit for NASA's Artemis lunar return. Heritage from the EMU but with mobility joints comparable to Apollo's A7LB, a regenerable amine CO₂ scrubber, HD video in the helmet, and dust-resistant joints for lunar surface use. Outer-layer styling by Prada.
Next-gen US EVA suit, to be tested on Artemis III

Axiom Space's contracted EVA suit for NASA's Artemis lunar return. Heritage from the EMU but with mobility joints comparable to Apollo's A7LB, a regenerable amine CO₂ scrubber, HD video in the helmet, and dust-resistant joints for lunar surface use. Outer-layer styling by Prada. In qualification testing; to be tested in Earth orbit on Artemis III (2027) and worn on the Moon from Artemis IV.
